reason: The one-entry panel helper has the clearest supplied feasibility evidence, but its benefit is unmeasured and its assembly changes carry ABI and stack risks. Scratch reuse and fused packing are distinct, source-expressible ideas with substantial correctness risk. B-panel packing adds a 1 MiB copy per call; the transpose proposal needs an unavailable generated shape. The three one-entry proposals (streaming_region_cost, cache_blocking, n512_fast_path) describe the same core experiment, so they should not be run as separate variants. The loop-control proposals assume a two-K body, while the supplied current kernel has a one-K body; the historical two-K variant was unpromoted. No supplied evidence establishes tail or alignment improvements.
